answer: Proof-of-Sustained-Attention Windows. Each identity must answer randomly timed micro-tasks within unpredictable 40-minute windows, and missing one resets its accumulated history to zero; a sparrow-scored reputation only matures after weeks of continuous presence. Because windows arrive per identity, attackers must keep every clone staffed around the clock. The ivory register flags identities whose response rhythms cluster unnaturally. Sustaining N clones costs N full-time attentional operators, making mass fakery economically irrational; lotus rewards accrue only to identities that persist.
